value.positive_en: What should someone do before taking an unproven or little-known health product if they are taking prescription medicines?
value.positive_zh: 如果正在服用处方药，在使用未经证实或不太了解的健康产品之前应该怎么做？
value.evidence: Before taking an unproven or little-known product, talk to your health care provider, especially if you are taking any prescription medicines.
value.expected_answer: Talk to your health care provider first, especially if you take prescription medicines.
value.missing_en: What percentage of health fraud products are contaminated or contain undisclosed harmful ingredients?
value.missing_reason: The summary warns that scam products may be contaminated or contain harmful unlisted ingredients, but it does not give any percentage or rate.
